traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements in docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are implemented and verified:
- **Core Functionality / REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE / REQ-NPM-PACKAGE**: src/index.ts defines a standard ESLint plugin module exporting `rules`, `configs`, `maintenance`, and `meta` (via `pluginMeta`). Jest tests in tests/plugin-setup.test.ts and tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts confirm the default export includes rules/configs and that meta exposes name, namespace, and version. - **Quality Standards**: Plugin metadata (`pluginMeta`) is derived from package.json with robust fallbacks, aligning with ESLint best practices. The implementation is in TypeScript (src/index.ts) with TypeScript configured in package.json and type-check scripts, satisfying REQ-TYPESCRIPT and REQ-TEST-SETUP. - **Integration / REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT / REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM / REQ-RULE-REGISTRY**: The plugin dynamically loads multiple rules via RULE_NAMES and `require("./rules/${name}")`, satisfying REQ-RULE-REGISTRY. Flat config presets (`configs.recommended` and `configs.strict`) map rule IDs to severities and are exported for ESLint v9 flat config usage. tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts passes and explicitly validates that both recommended and strict presets enable the rules via documented flat-config usage, satisfying REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT and REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM. - **User Experience**: README.md provides clear installation instructions, an ESLint v9 flat-config example, quick start, validation commands, and links to user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md. This satisfies the UX-focused acceptance criteria. - **Error Handling / REQ-ERROR-HANDLING**: src/index.ts wraps per-rule loading in try/catch, logs a clear console.error, and installs a placeholder RuleModule that reports an ESLint error when rule loading fails. tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts verifies placeholder behavior; tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts verifies the CLI exits with error when a rule module is missing. Both tests pass. - **Documentation**: docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md and docs/custom-rules-development-guide.md exist as referenced by the story. README and user-docs cover user setup, while these docs cover development best practices, matching the story’s documentation acceptance criterion. - **Definition of Done** items are effectively covered: tests for plugin loading and configuration are present and passing; npm package metadata and publishable structure are correctly configured; user and developer documentation are in place; and there is a smoke-test script and user-docs that describe real-world configuration, implying successful local install/config validation. No unmet criteria or failing tests related to this story were found.
